prompt: Some people think that boys and girls should attend school together. Others feel that they should be educated separately. Discuss both sides and give your own opinion.
essay:
In recent years, there has been a growing debate about whether teaching sport in schools is a waste of hour and resources. While some people believe that including athletics in the school curriculum is unnecessary, others argue that sports play a vital role in education. This essay will discuss both views before presenting my own opinion.

Firstly, many people believe that students should spend more time on academic subjects.The primary reason is that academic subjects are more important for higher education and future careers.This can be explained by the fact that Students have limited time at school, so more time should be spent on mathematics, science, and languages. For instance, many countries introduced modern teaching methods, which have helped students by improving their academic performance and communication skills. Consequently, students achieve better academic results and have more career opportunities.

However, few argue that sports play a vital role in students' overall development. They claim that sports improve physical health, teamwork, and self-confidence. Regular exercise reduces stress and helps students maintain a healthy lifestyle. A good example of this is schools that include regular sports activities, where students develop teamwork, leadership, and communication skills.  As a result, students become healthier, more confident, and perform better both inside and outside the classroom. From my perspective, sports should remain part of the school curriculum because they support both physical and mental development while helping students build essential life skills.

To conclude, although both views have their own merits, I believe that sports should remain an important part of education because they contribute to students' physical health, personal development, and academic success. Overall, this approach would provide long-term benefits for both individuals and society.
